acceptanceCriteria: Use the official strike or opening reference and preserve receipt-causal timing
Apply family-wise correction across all opening-window cells and require consistency across neighboring horizons
Record the rejection without promoting its best post-selected cell
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Closed rejection. Three-second cells showed +4.79c and +6.15c with uncorrected p near 0.04, but failed multiplicity and the 10-second and 30-second variants were negative. Asian180 collapsed to +0.22c, p=0.48 after using the official strike.

userStories.title: Reject single-sided maker queue capture
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want the passive single-sided maker hypothesis recorded separately from complementary maker pairs so its adverse-selection result is not mistaken for an untested execution improvement.
acceptanceCriteria: Evaluate passive fills with queue ordering, adverse selection, cancellation timing and settlement rather than assuming displayed-touch execution
Keep single-sided maker capture distinct from US-023 complementary pairs and from source-confirmed taker execution
Record the validation rejection and do not recycle the selected cells
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Closed rejection. None of ten selected maker cells passed validation, and even fills without a preceding adverse jump lost 2.55c/share.
